text:
matt_sales: OceanShift wants a 5-day POC with their in-house model 'cobalt-alpha-34b-v2' for low-latency chat + RAG. They uploaded artifacts and asked about compatibility, timeline, and a ballpark POC price. Can SE/infra/security triage?
zira_se: What format and tokenizer did they provide? Any notes on attention type or custom ops?
matt_sales: They dropped a HF tar.gz with safetensors, tokenizer.json, and a README claiming 40k native context. They also included a small eval set (250 queries).
zira_se: 40k is within our upper limits but we need to confirm whether they rely on sliding-window attention or full context; also check rotary vs ALiBi. Tokenizer sanity check first: if it's sentencepiece we should be fine, if it's custom merges we may need an adapter.
dan_infra: Infra quick calc: cobalt-alpha-34b-v2 at 4-bit + 40k KV -> expect ~2.5-3.5GB KV per long session. Single 80GB node can run low-concurrency tests; concurrency >4 likely requires Dedicated sharded setup. For Hosted isolated sandbox we can pin a node but cost/latency will be higher.
zira_se: SE plan: run tokenizer pass, build three variants (4-bit, 8-bit, fp16), run their 250-query eval vs our baseline, perf sweep at ctx slices (512 / 8k / 40k) and concurrencies (1/3/6). ETA ~3 business days after artifacts validated unless there are custom ops.
hannah_security: Security: because it's customer-supplied we need license provenance and an SCA scan. README says "commercial use allowed with attribution"  good but legal still wants to verify dependencies. If they require no-host-copy we must use Private/VPC. For Hosted we require the artifact to be staged into isolated tenant storage with KMS envelope and a temporary build copy; if that conflicts with their license it's a blocker. Also DPA required if PII will flow in during the POC.
matt_sales: They specifically asked whether we can avoid copying artifacts to our hosts and whether that affects the timeline.
dan_infra: We can support a streaming-from-S3 approach in Private (VPC) so artifacts never live on multi-tenant machines. That adds network/IAM setup ~3-5 business days. For Hosted we do a transient copy during build; if they won't allow that, Hosted is off the table.
zira_se: Ops snippet to send them for artifact upload + eval attach:
```
# upload artifacts to our secure staging (customer can also grant a presigned URL):
rw model upload --name cobalt-alpha-34b-v2 --format hf --files model.safetensors tokenizer.json config.json --visibility private --kms arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:9999:key/abcd1234

# attach eval set for automated QC:
rw model attach-eval --name cobalt-alpha-34b-v2 --evalset s3://oceanshift-evals/250-queries.json --notify zira_se
```
matt_sales: Pricing: they want a rough Hosted isolated vs Dedicated week number and any one-time variant validation fee to include in the SOW.
zira_se: Very rough ballpark: Hosted isolated sandbox (1 pinned 80GB node, operator) ~= $4k/day. Dedicated minimal (2x A100-80GB reserved for a week, no autoscale) ~= $20k-25k for the week depending on egress/KMS. Variant validation fee (one-time) ~= $1,500. Get finance to confirm.
hannah_security: Also call out blockers for the sales email in one line: 1) license/provenance & SCA sign-off required (can block Hosted), 2) 40k KV memory overhead may force Dedicated at modest concurrency, 3) custom ops in the HF config could add 1-2 days for shims.
dan_infra: Note: if they rely on an external vector DB for RAG, include egress and auth integration in the plan  that adds latency and may require allowlist.
matt_sales: Great. I'll ask them to stage eval set, confirm whether they accept a transient build copy for Hosted, and share desired concurrency and traffic profile. Zira  please start the builds when artifacts arrive.
zira_se: Will watch staging and kick off the 4-bit variant + perf sweep when files validate.
deploy-bot: task created: SE-9001 "OceanShift cobalt-alpha-34b-v2 POC variant & perf" assigned to zira_se, due 2025-04-21. :robot_face:
